{"m": "gpt-4o", "msg": [{"content": "You compare short personal anecdotes by their underlying relational structure - the pattern of intentions, causes, deceptions, reversals, and outcomes among the people involved - NOT by their surface topic, setting, or vocabulary. Two stories can be about totally different situations yet share the same deep structure; two stories can share the same topic yet have opposite structure.", "role": "system"}, {"content": "SITUATION:
My in-laws bought us our house as a wedding gift, insisting it was unconditional. Two years in, they've redecorated the guest room to their taste, installed landscaping without asking, and invited relatives to stay without consulting us. When we object, they remind us whose generosity made this possible.

CANDIDATE A:
My godfather paid for my college education with no stated expectations. At graduation, he presented a contract for five years of work at his company at below-market rates. He called it 'internship terms' and suggested my degree would be worthless without his 'practical training.'

CANDIDATE B:
My in-laws bought us our house as a wedding gift and said it was ours to do with as we pleased. When we repainted the guest room they'd decorated and turned down a visit from their relatives, they said it was our home and our call. Two years on, they've never once brought up the money.

Which candidate shares the same underlying relational structure as the SITUATION (ignore surface topic similarity)? Respond as JSON: {"choice": "A" or "B", "reason": "<one sentence>"}.", "role": "user"}], "t": 0.0, "tag": "exp2:48"}
content: {"choice": "A", "reason": "Both involve a gift given with the appearance of no strings attached, followed by the giver imposing conditions or expectations that contradict the initial promise."}
